answer: Because the timing is recorded against the basalt challenge, the nadir audit can replay the whisper history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm therefore has to pad 63 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. A farm of 3653 identities would post 3069 proofs and burn roughly 50 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
